flags.message: The frozen distribution_count of 1 reflects the June 10, 2026 distribution of the petitioners' sealing motion (25M91) for the June 25 conference, not a distribution of the cert petition itself — the brief in opposition is not due until August 26, 2026, so the petition has never been considered on the merits of cert. I anchored on the frozen baseline band per the contract and stated relist-increment (0.97) from the frozen count of 1; the increment claim remains well-posed, but readers of the band should know the petition is effectively pre-distribution.

This is a famous, heavily covered case (the 9/11 military-commission plea-agreement mandamus) and I carry background knowledge of it from training, including the D.C. Circuit decision under review — which is also on the provisioned record. The cert disposition does not exist yet (forward mode) and nothing outcome-revealing was retrieved; noting the prior familiarity for transparency.
